head: New Siri Remote: Precision Finding needs an iPhone 17 or newer
dek: The new Siri Remote that comes with the Apple TV 4K on Friday can be found with Precision Finding, but only from an iPhone 17 or newer.
details: The remote also has a speaker you can ring from the Find My app, which works with older iPhones. It works with earlier Apple TV 4K and Apple TV HD models and is sold separately too.
means: With an older iPhone, you can still make the remote beep, but not get step-by-step directions to it.
todo: Before buying the remote mainly for Precision Finding, check that your iPhone is an iPhone 17 or newer.
